recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片可見互相吻合、充滿紅血球的大小不一血管腔隙，部分呈囊狀擴張並有乳突狀突起，左側保留正常白髓淋巴組織；此血管性病灶取代紅髓，符合脾臟 littoral cell angioma。
features: Low-power splenic tissue with anastomosing, blood-filled vascular channels of variable size
Cystically dilated spaces with papillary projections into lumina
Channels lined by plump cells separated by fibrous and cellular septa
Residual white pulp lymphoid tissue at left edge
Lining cell detail (hobnail/tall cells, hemophagocytosis) not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Sections of spleen at low power show a vascular lesion composed of anastomosing, blood-filled channels of variable caliber, including cystically dilated spaces with papillary projections, separated by fibrous and cellular septa. Residual white pulp is present at the periphery. No solid atypical cellular proliferation or necrosis is evident at this magnification, though the cytology of the lining cells requires high-power examination. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma, confirmed by the characteristic hybrid endothelial-histiocytic immunophenotype (CD31+, CD68+, CD163+, CD21+, CD8−, CD34−).

ddx.vs: Hemangioma channels are lined by flat CD34+/CD31+ endothelium that is negative for CD68, CD163, and CD21.
Angiosarcoma shows cytologic atypia, solid areas, mitoses, necrosis, and infiltrative growth.
SANT forms multiple angiomatoid nodules with a mixture of CD34+ capillaries, CD8+ sinusoids, and CD31-only small veins, surrounded by concentric fibrosis.
Peliosis consists of blood-filled cysts lacking a true lining cell proliferation or papillary projections.
